keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Lewis Koumas (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
James McConnell (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Goal! Liverpool 0, Chelsea 1. Morgan Rogers (Chelsea) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Goal! Liverpool 1, Chelsea 1. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Maxence Lacroix (Chelsea).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Chelsea. Levi Colwill replaces Maxence Lacroix because of an injury.
Second Half begins Liverpool 1, Chelsea 1.
Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Liverpool. Bradley Barcola replaces Lewis Koumas.
Substitution, Liverpool. Florian Wirtz replaces James McConnell.
Substitution, Chelsea. Emmanuel Emegha replaces Danny Welbeck.
Substitution, Chelsea. Marco Palestra replaces Malo Gusto.
Substitution, Chelsea. Valentín Barco replaces Moisés Caicedo.
Substitution, Liverpool. Jérémy Jacquet replaces Virgil van Dijk.
Roméo Lavia (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Wesley Fofana (Chelsea).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Liverpool. Alexis Mac Allister replaces Trey Nyoni.
Substitution, Liverpool. Alexander Isak replaces Rio Ngumoha.
Second Half ends, Liverpool 1, Chelsea 1.
Penalty Shootout begins Liverpool 1, Chelsea 1.
